summary: Clean-state check runs git status/ls-files with repository-local config honored (only system/global config and GIT_* env are stripped), so hidden local Git configuration can mask tracked worktree drift.
failure_scenario: Candidate checkout has .git/config core.fileMode=false (or core.fsmonitor/other status-affecting local keys) and a tracked file whose mode was changed in the worktree -> _require_clean_tracked_state returns without error and the candidate identity is issued for a worktree that differs from HEAD, while the same checkout without that config is refused as drift.
evidence: Model-free repro in a temp repo: after chmod +x on a committed file, _require_clean_tracked_state raises 'tracked index/worktree drift' by default, but after `git config core.fileMode false` it passes silently. Only the fileMode variant was run; fsmonitor/other keys are unproved. Fix: pass -c core.fileMode=true -c core.fsmonitor=false -c diff.ignoreSubmodules=none (or equivalents) on status/ls-files, as release_gate already pins attribute/diff options. No existing test sets local config beyond user.name/email.

summary: Only RuntimeError from release_gate.canonical_baseline_diff_sha256 is wrapped; a failing git diff/rev-list (check=True) escapes as CalledProcessError, not ArtifactOrchestrationError.
failure_scenario: Git rejects a diff option (observed with exit 129 on git 2.43.0 for the pinned --output-indicator-* flags, or any failing rev-list/diff) -> callers catching ArtifactOrchestrationError see an unhandled subprocess.CalledProcessError instead of the typed refusal.
evidence: Reproduced in the temp repo: verify_clean_tracked_candidate raised CalledProcessError with the diff command and status 129. The root cause on this git version (flag support) is environmental; the missing wrap is source-visible at lines 94-98. Fail-closed still holds (no identity returned).
